story.title: Story 3: Turn Construction and Recovery Cascade

result.planSummary: Resolved SV-03-001 by making recovery write-back update only pending/failed rows, so an already-ready worker result survives a late floor persistence attempt. Resolved SV-03-002 by adding focused Story 3 coverage for TC-3.2c, TC-3.4a, TC-3.5a, plus the TC-3.8d ready-row race. TC-3.7a evidence remains the turn-cascade test that opens BEGIN IMMEDIATE inside provider recovery and asserts probeAcquired true, proving provider recovery runs outside the completion write transaction.

changedFiles.reason: Guarded recoverDerivation write-back to persist recovered ready content only over pending or failed rows, leaving already-ready worker output untouched.
Added original-source prompt fallback when deterministic prompt floor is unavailable.
Added focused coverage for floor-unavailable fallback, verbatim assistant/thinking/runtime ordering, multiple not-ready components, and the ready-row recovery write-back race.

added: packages/lhc/test/turn-cascade.test.ts: falls back to original prompt source when the deterministic floor is unavailable
packages/lhc/test/turn-cascade.test.ts: does not overwrite a ready row written before floor recovery persists
packages/lhc/test/turn-cascade.test.ts: renders assistant text, thinking, and runtime notes verbatim in record order
packages/lhc/test/turn-cascade.test.ts: constructs a turn with every component present when multiple derivations are not ready

gatesRun.command: cd packages/lhc && pnpm exec vitest run test/turn-cascade.test.ts

findingsFixed: SV-03-001: recoverDerivation now has state IN ('pending', 'failed') in the write-back predicate; the new race test writes 'real worker output' before floor persistence and asserts that content survives while the floor still renders.
SV-03-002: TC-3.2c, TC-3.4a, and TC-3.5a now have direct assertions in packages/lhc/test/turn-cascade.test.ts.
TC-3.8d evidence: existing live-work test asserts pending row plus live work item remain, and new ready-row race test asserts worker-produced ready content survives recovery floor write-back.
TC-3.7a evidence: existing recovery test asserts probeAcquired true after opening BEGIN IMMEDIATE from inside provider smoothPrompt, proving recovery provider work is outside SDK DB write completion.

result.recommendedNextStep: Run story verifier again for Story 3.
